concept: IAM: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent condition to require MFA for risky actions
tests: How to require MFA only for S3 object deletion without denying deletion outright.
expected: Allow s3:DeleteObject in the IAM policy with Condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent = true. Triggers: "require MFA for any deletion", "MOST secure", least-privilege roles.
why_not: An explicit Deny blocks deletion entirely; Versioning protects against loss but doesn't require MFA; bucket ACLs can't express MFA conditions.
